name: mr-tapioca
description: Mr. Tapioca — boba focus app. Web app + Capacitor iOS shell (with a native Screen Time blocker).

scripts.copyweb: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html styles.css app.js config.js squad-cloud.js metrics.js analytics.js notifications.js reward-config.js reward-v2.js sw.js manifest.json www/ && cp -R assets www/assets && find www -name '.DS_Store' -delete
scripts.ios:sync: npm run copyweb && npx cap sync ios && node tools/register-ios-plugins.mjs
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
